sections.name: architecture
sections.value:
Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md (tenets 1-6); repo instantiation per docs/rules-idioms-architecture/fs3-architecture.md (binding). THE INVARIANT ABOVE ALL: the frozen JSON envelope is the product's agent contract — rendering is a PRESENTATION layer added AFTER envelope production, never a change to it (ac-0002 byte-goldens enforce this mechanically). Placement: output-mode decision fn in CORE (pure); the Renderer seam + human renderers in CLI (crates/cli — presentation is shell, and the render path may depend on ratatui-adjacent crates the daemon must never carry); event emission in DAEMON at work-completion points, served via the existing daemon HTTP surface as an NDJSON stream endpoint the CLI consumes for --watch and tui; the tui verb in CLI. Allow-list grants: cli -> ratatui + crossterm (two rows); cli -> the render support crates the POC's LEARNINGS justify (each a named row, PM-granted at phase 1 from the LEARNINGS list, not improvised); NO new daemon dependencies (the stream uses what the daemon already serves HTTP with). INTERFACES SETTLED PHASE 1: output-mode fn signature + precedence table; Renderer trait; --watch NDJSON wire types (versioned). Authoritative inputs: pocs/human-render/LEARNINGS.md (promotion shape — the POC already named it), scratch/tui-poc/VERDICT.md (vendor into assets/inputs/ — scratch is gitignored, refs must resolve where seats live), DL-045 (the mocked-feed gap). Jordan rulings 2026-08-28 verbatim: default human output with --json available; TUI POC verdict accepted, React deferred.

AMENDED 2026-08-28 (prime ruling B, on PM evidence): the fan-out below claimed zero shared files, and it was wrong. The per-verb payload DTOs u-r must read lived inside u-w's fence (Hit/SearchResults at crates/daemon/src/search.rs:84,113) and u-r's own module (Step/DoctorReport at crates/cli/src/doctor.rs:61,216) — pocs/human-render/LEARNINGS.md §3.1 names that move as THE design decision of the promotion, and the impl-guide had not carried it. Retired in phase 1 as tk-a106: the DTOs now live in fs3_core::views, byte-neutrally, proven by the tk-a103 goldens captured before the move. The collision surface is back to zero and tenet 3 holds.

AMENDED 2026-08-28 (Jordan, scope addition): `flowspace3 add` must show a real progress indicator in human mode. Folded into the phase-1 freeze rather than bolted on later — the frozen wire contract carries a scan_progress event, so the meter is fed by what the daemon is ACTUALLY walking instead of a spinner that knows nothing. It makes add-progress a u-w (emit) plus u-r (render, on stderr) joint deliverable behind frozen types; stdout is untouched, so the byte-goldens hold by construction.

value.rationale: Three genuinely independent units behind phase-1 seams: u-r (CLI render), u-w (daemon stream), u-t (tui verb). Zero shared files: u-r owns the render module + per-verb renderers, u-w owns daemon event emission + the stream endpoint, u-t owns the tui module; each exports through its own one-line hook. u-t consumes u-w's WIRE TYPES (frozen phase 1), not its implementation — it builds against a recorded NDJSON fixture until composition, so all three run wave 1 in parallel. Phase 1 solo-PM; phase 3 PM composes.

value.name: renderer promotion
value.paths: crates/cli render module + per-verb renderers + output-mode wiring; CLAUDE.md, .agents/skills/flowspace/SKILL.md, agents-start-here + self-teaching docs; POC fixtures as goldens
value.responsibility: Human-default output on covered verbs per the decision function; agent-path docs updated.
value.interface: Renderer seam (frozen ph-1); envelope production untouched (byte-goldens).
value.test_strategy: Four-case matrix per verb (tty/piped x json/human flags); byte-stability vs goldens; cargo test -p fs3-cli offline.
value.note: pocs/human-render is the reference implementation — port, don't re-derive; LEARNINGS.md is authoritative on crate choices.

value.name: daemon event stream
value.paths: crates/daemon event emission + NDJSON stream endpoint; docs/services/event-stream.md
value.responsibility: Real events at completion points; status --watch serving; multi-subscriber; heartbeat.
value.interface: The frozen wire types (ph-1); no daemon dep additions.
value.test_strategy: Contract tests over wire types; two-subscriber identity test; emission tests at each completion point via existing test harnesses.
value.note: Emission points are where the runner already logs done — mirror those seams, do not invent new lifecycle.

value.name: the tui verb
value.paths: crates/cli tui module (+ ratatui/crossterm allowlist rows); docs/services/tui.md
value.responsibility: The dashboard per the POC verdict: roots, operations, REAL activity via --watch, results-dominant search.
value.interface: Consumes CLI JSON surface + frozen wire types; builds against a recorded NDJSON fixture until composition.
value.test_strategy: Layout/state logic unit-tested headless; stream consumption against the fixture; manual transcript at first light.
value.depends_on: phase 1 (types); composition joins it to live u-w
value.note: scratch/tui-poc is reference only — product code fresh in-crate; the POC's VERDICT pain list (truncation, input) is the polish checklist.

Own worktrees off 007-human-interface, PM merges, coders never merge. ABSOLUTE PATHS always (DL-007/008); ASSUMPTIONS section + prove-in-tree evidence in done reports; PIJ_SESSION_ID export; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; no docker compose up (shared db 5433); rustc-LLVM IO failure = disk; Avail figure in every report; toolchain pinned, receipts carry observed versions.

value.steps: Ask each done coder its ASSUMPTIONS first. Merge u-w, then u-r, then u-t (u-t re-pointed from fixture to live stream at this step — that swap is the composition risk, rehearse it first). Gate green on composed tree; run first light (tk-a302). Unit-internal rework here = phase-1 defect: stop, record, rule.
value.integration_proof: tk-a302's one-session transcript: human output live, piped byte-check, tui running on the real stream during a real scan.

value.when: after phase-3 composition, before the PR
value.inputs: plan + impl-guide + full diff; priority: ac-0002 byte-stability (the agent contract), the four-case output matrix, stream liveness/subscriber correctness, tui degradation when the daemon is down, doc-path completeness (ac-0005)

value.text: Breaking the agent contract silently — retired by ac-0002 byte-goldens captured from pre-plan main, asserted every gate.

Agents running in PTYs (tmux seats!) suddenly getting human output — retired by the FS3_OUTPUT env override + agent-path doc updates + our own harness/skill files setting it; first light includes a pij-seat check.
u-t building against a stream that composition changes — retired by frozen wire types + the fixture-to-live swap named as the rehearsed composition step.
Renderer crate creep in the CLI — retired by named allowlist rows granted only from the POC's LEARNINGS list.

add-progress arriving late and forcing a wire-type change after fan-out — retired by folding Jordan's 2026-08-28 scope addition into the phase-1 freeze: scan_progress is in the frozen vocabulary from the start, emitted by u-w and rendered by u-r on STDERR, so stdout stays byte-identical.

A renderer built on hand-mirrored payload types drifting from the daemon that produces them — retired by tk-a106, which moved the DTOs into fs3_core::views so producer and consumer read one definition. This risk was INVISIBLE in the first draft of this guide; it surfaced at the PM ack, which is what the ack is for.
